# fast-sha256 1.3.0

`sha256.mjs` is the public-domain fast-sha256 1.3.0 implementation with its
UMD wrapper adapted to export `Hash` as ESM. The implementation was compared
with `sha256.js` from the official npm tarball, ignoring the wrapper and
formatting. The original license is included in this directory.

- Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/fast-sha256/-/fast-sha256-1.3.0.tgz
